test_rolling_cov: test the rolling covariance computation between two series using pandas rolling window
test_rolling_corr: test the rolling correlation computation between two series using pandas rolling window
test_rolling_corr_bias_correction: test rolling correlation with correct bias correction across series with NaN values
test_flex_binary_frame: test rolling corr and cov operations between a series and a dataframe pairwise
test_rolling_corr_with_zero_variance: test rolling correlation behavior when one series has zero variance
test_corr_sanity: test rolling correlation values stay within [-1, 1] bounds
test_rolling_cov_diff_length: test rolling covariance between series with different index lengths
test_rolling_corr_diff_length: test rolling correlation between series with different index lengths
test_time_based_rolling_other_longer_rai: test that time-based rolling cov/corr raises error when other series is longer
test_rolling_functions_window_non_shrink: test rolling cov and corr with pairwise=True return MultiIndex DataFrame
test_moment_functions_zero_length_pairwi: test rolling cov and corr pairwise on empty or zero-length dataframes
test_pairwise_with_self: test rolling, expanding, and ewm cov/corr with pairwise=True on dataframe with itself
test_pairwise_with_other: test rolling, expanding, and ewm cov/corr with pairwise=True between two dataframes
test_no_pairwise_with_other: test rolling cov/corr with pairwise=False between two dataframes
test_pairwise_with_series: test rolling, expanding, and ewm cov/corr between dataframe and series
test_corr_freq_memory_error: test rolling correlation with time-based frequency on series
test_cov_multitindex: test ewm covariance computation with MultiIndex columns
test_multindex_columns_pairwise_func: test rolling correlation with MultiIndex columns
